The train chassis can be placed on tracks. After placing a Driver's Seat and an Electric Motor Engine on it, you can drive it along the tracks.


1. Press Y while aiming at a derailed train to place it back on the tracks.


2. Drive the train into another Train Chassis to connect them together.


3. The train's maximum speed is 100 km/h. Mass has very little effect on the train's movement speed, so very few motors can drive a very heavy train.
